dob_now_build_job_application_filings.query: Retrieve Job Application Filings data from DOB NOW For each borough, list the top 10 construction projects by initial cost For each selected construction project, retrieve its block number For each selected construction project, retrieve its construction floor area Rank the selected construction projects by floor area within each borough

DOB NOW： Build – Job Application Filings_job_application_filings_1
DOB NOW： Build – Job Application Filings_job_application_filings_2
dob_now_build_job_application_filings.sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        t4.block, 
        t5.block, 
        t5.borough, t3.initial_cost, t4.total_construction_floor_area,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t5.borough ORDER BY t3.initial_cost DESC) as rank, 
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t5.borough ORDER BY t4.total_construction_floor_area DESC) as dense_rank 
    FROM "node_1" t1
    INNER JOIN "DOB NOW： Build – Job Application Filings_job_application_filings_3" t2 ON t1.job_filing_number = t2.job_filing_number
    INNER JOIN "DOB NOW： Build – Job Application Filings_job_application_filings" t3 ON t1.bin = t3.bin
    INNER JOIN "DOB NOW： Build – Job Application Filings_job_application_filings_1" t4 ON t2.latitude = t4.latitude AND t2.longitude = t4.longitude
    INNER JOIN "DOB NOW： Build – Job Application Filings_job_application_filings_2" t5 ON t4.block = t5.block
) 
SELECT 
    block, borough, initial_cost, total_construction_floor_area, -- {{select_columns}}
    rank, 
    dense_rank 
FROM ranked 
WHERE rank <= 10

dohmh_childcare_center_inspections.query: Retrieve all records from the 'Inspections from DOHMH Childcare Center' dataset For each record, retrieve the childcare type For each record, retrieve the violation status For each record, retrieve the legal name of the childcare center For each record, retrieve the regulation summary For each record, retrieve the permit number For each record, retrieve the critical violation rate For each record, retrieve the capacity of the facility
dohmh_childcare_center_inspections.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT
    t2.legalname,
    t5.legalname AS t5_legalname,
    t2.bin,
    t6.bin AS t6_bin,
    t4.inspectiondate,
    t2.childcaretype,
    t4.violationratepercent,
    t2.violationstatus,
    t2.permitnumber,

  INNER JOIN "DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records" AS t2

    ON t2.bin = t6.bin

)
SELECT

  legalname,
  regulationsummary,
  COUNT(*) AS record_count,
  SUM(permitnumber) AS total_amount,
  AVG(avgcriticalviolationrate) AS avg_amount,
  MAX(criticalviolationrate) AS max_amount,

  violationstatus,
  legalname,
  regulationsummary

asbestos_control_program_acp7.sql:
WITH categorized_data AS (
  SELECT
    t3.borough,
    t3.block,
    t4.community_board,
    t4.floor,
    t4.entire_floor,
    t5.street_name,
    t5.nta,

  SUM(community_board) as total_value,

  WHERE         t1.graduation_rate IS NOT NULL         AND t5.neighborhood IS NOT NULL), aggregated AS (    SELECT         dbn,        school_name,        neighborhood,         method1,         SUM(graduation_rate) as total_rate_sum,         COUNT(*) as program_count,                      AVG(graduation_rate) as average_graduation_rate     FROM base_data     GROUP BY         dbn,        school_name,        neighborhood,         method1) SELECT     dbn,    school_name,    neighborhood,    method1,    program_count,    average_graduation_rate,    total_rate_sum as total FROM aggregated WHERE average_graduation_rate > 0 ORDER BY average_graduation_rate DESC LIMIT 100;
